default.description: Engram Dashboard default permissions — core event listen/emit allowed (needed to receive state broadcasts such as agent-list-updated). core:window:allow-start-dragging — Tauri drag.js turns a press on the title-bar drag area (data-tauri-drag-region) into a window drag (without it dragging silently fails · the double-press maximize toggle is in core:default · TRD S26-window-chrome §7-2 · §9). Window buttons and state commands are shell invokes (window_control), so no window-control permission is granted (AC10).

popup.description: Permissions of windows created at runtime by slot pop-out (slot-popup-*) — they must be able to use the same IPC surface as the main window (subscribe_output/request_replay/forward_daemon_command/layout queries) to subscribe to and render their own View. core:default (invoke/window) + core:event:default (event listen such as layout:updated). ★The window-close permission (core:window:allow-close) is not granted★ — zero-tab self-closing and window buttons go through the shell invoke (window_control), LLM closing goes through the bus window.close or the same invoke (both the same shell service), and the web does not call the window API (TRD S26-window-chrome §5-4 · §5-5 · §9 · AC10). core:window:allow-start-dragging — window drag from the title-bar drag area (same as main · §7-2). dialog:allow-open — the agent tree slot (agent_list) can also be placed in a popup window (set_slot_content), so the folder picker of that slot menu's 'create agent' must work in popup windows too (minimum permission: open only). The opener permission for usage slot links is granted by usage-links.json to these windows together with main.

usage-links.description: The 「usage page ↗」 link of the usage slot — narrows opener:allow-open-url to two addresses only (the Claude and Codex usage settings pages) (TRD S21 usage-limit-slot §1-7). The windows are main and pop-outs (slot-popup-*) — those two are the only windows that hold a slot. The list of the two addresses lives in this file only (default.json and popup.json carry no separate opener permission).
